text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training with Mejiro
Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh... My body feels sluggish. This is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My legs just feel a little... A short break
is all I—
choice_data_list: No, let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry. This is all down to my own

negligence.
choice_data_list: No. It's negligence on my part as your Trainer.
No. It's negligence on my part as your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like the consecutive races
Mejiro Ardan
has been participating in
lately have put
considerable strain on
her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd better review the racing schedule and
make
some revisions to ensure she won't
have so many
races back-to-back
anymore.
